ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.12 combines the wider custom-global Work search coverage explored in V0.4.11 with the stable 16-cell spatial-ring ordering validated in V0.4.10. Supported current-call candidate sets are partitioned near-to-far while preserving original candidate order inside each ring, helping Vanilla establish a useful best-distance earlier without fully reordering WorkGiver scan semantics. Candidate membership is unchanged. Vanilla region search, Reachability.CanReach, WorkGiver validators, reservations, priorities and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Exact ListerHaulables searches remain separated from the PUAH/V0.4.6/V0.4.7 hauling paths. V0.4.8 bounded slow JobPackage tracing, path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
